decisions.reason: This chart visualization plugin still fits the firm's web-GIS platform business well, but as a modular add-on from 2018 it carries some medium lifecycle risk if resources are concentrated on broader platform capabilities.

The mobile layer control component addresses a real usability need, yet mobile UI components age quickly and may face replacement or absorption into newer frameworks, so we would keep it with caution.
As the firm's flagship GIS solution platform and strategic core, it remains central to the portfolio and is very unlikely to be withdrawn.
Mobile field data capture remains a strong fit with integrated enterprise geospatial solutions and customer processes, so it should stay in the portfolio despite normal product-refresh risk.

This search extension is useful but comparatively easy to subsume into the core platform or replace with project-specific development, so we would withdraw it and redirect resources to the established platform and new development.
